thread:
deploy-bot: Starting hourly rollout batch 1/6 for release r-2026.03.21-6 to pool: dedicated-eu (nodes: eu-01..eu-05). ETA per node ~6m.
ops_mike: tagging this thread 'customer-notify' — drafting statuspage snippet now.
sre_julia: quick note — can we pin model versions on the affected routes before traffic shift? I recommend pinning to v2.4.1 for the first 2 hours.
ops_mike: yes, doing pin for /api/generate and /api/chat on dedicated-eu. Command: `redwoodctl pin --pool dedicated-eu --route /api/generate --model v2.4.1`
support_lead: cc @customer-comm — customer-friendly blurb below. Pls review: "We are performing a staged maintenance to improve inference latency in EU; brief request routing switches expected, no data access changes."
customer-comm: Wording looks good, add expected window: "2026-03-21 22:00-02:00 UTC" and a note about fallback: "Requests will automatically fall back to hosted pool if dedicated capacity is constrained."
alice_prod: batch 1 completed on eu-01..eu-03. Observed 12% latency reduction p50 on /api/generate. No errors.
deploy-bot: Batch 1 ✅ (eu-01..eu-03). Next batch scheduled in 8m.
sre_julia: monitoring KV cache warmup — prefix cache hit rate at 74% after batch 1, aiming 85% within two batches.
support_lead: Drafting statuspage entry now. Proposed body: ```Scheduled maintenance: Staged inference rollout in EU to improve latency. Impact: minimal routing delays (seconds) for some requests. Window: 2026-03-21 22:00-02:00 UTC. We will post updates after each hourly batch.```
customer-comm: LGTM. Include contact link and guidance: "If you notice consistent 5xx errors, contact support with trace id."
ops_mike: batch 2 started (eu-04..eu-05). Pin remains active. Rolling config: canary routing 5% -> 100% over 3 minutes.
alice_prod: seeing a transient spike of token-generation errors on eu-05 at 22:28:13 UTC (trace id: a1b2c3). Rate 500s at ~0.6% of requests.
sre_julia: investigating. Can we throttle new long-sequence requests to eu-05? Applying routing rule now: `route-weight --pool eu-05 --route /api/generate --weight 20%`
deploy-bot: Applied route-weight change; traffic rebalanced to other nodes.
ops_mike: Customer statuspage update (post-batch 2): "Batch 2 in progress — minor transient errors observed on a single node; automated routing has reduced user impact. Monitoring closely."
support_lead: Preparing customer email snippet to send if impact persists >30m.
customer-comm: Also prep a rollback-ready snippet: "We may pause the rollout and revert routing if errors continue; we'll notify customers within 15 minutes of a pause."
sre_julia: Root cause looks like kernel OOM on eu-05 when handling long-context quantized models. Memory thresholds at 92%. Working on temp config to lower max_seq for eu-05.
alice_prod: applied max_seq=2048 on eu-05, errors dropped to background rate 0.05%.
deploy-bot: Batch 2 ✅ (eu-04..eu-05). Overall rollout progress 2/6.
ops_mike: Posting consolidated status update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/rollout-eu-2026-03-21 and pinging customers with active dedicated contracts in EU.
support_lead: Snippet for customer DM (short): "We completed two batches of our EU inference rollout. You may have seen brief routing delays; if you experience persistent errors, reply to this thread or open a ticket referencing rollout-eu-2026-03-21."
alice_prod: handoff to night ops in 40m — I'll include a small runbook in the handoff: 1) check KV cache hit rate, 2) verify pin status for critical routes, 3) monitor node memory, 4) trigger rollback if >1% 5xx sustained for 15m.
customer-comm: Please include exact commands for the runbook.
ops_mike: Runbook excerpt to include: ```# verify pins
redwoodctl list-pins --pool dedicated-eu
# check cache
redwoodctl stats cache --pool dedicated-eu | grep hit_rate
# rollback
redwoodctl rollback --release r-2026.03.21-6 --reason "sustained errors"
```
sre_julia: adding note — if rollback occurs, remember to disable the canary prefix cache invalidation job: `cron disable cache-warmup-canary` to avoid cache storms.
ops_mike: final: scheduling hourly batches 3..6 at :00 of the next hours. I'll update statuspage after each batch.
support_lead: last note before handoff — saved customer-facing release notes (short): "Performance improvements deployed to EU dedicated pools; no data migration; transparent fallback to hosted API available."
customer-comm: Acknowledged, will send handoff email to customers in 30m with links to status page and the runbook.
deploy-bot: Thread closed for batch 2; next progress updates will be appended by ops_mike.
